paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw nangmah ah ka ginna ka nga a; hon delh tengteng lak ah hon hondam in hon humbit in;
heading: David La, Benjamin Mi Kush Ziak A / Dikna Ngen A Thumna

paite: huchi lou in zaw, humbitpa om lou in humpinelkai bang in, ka hinna abotnen kha ding hi.
TOUPA ka Pathian aw, huchibang a hih ka na hih a, ka khut a khelhna a-om a,
ka lawm khelhna a thuk ka na hihleh, ahi, bangmah lou a hon dou ka humbit ana hi zaw.
Melma in ka hinna delh in, delhpha mai hen aw; ahi, ka hinna lei ah chilpuk in, ka thupina leivui lak ah koih mai hen. Selah
TOUPA aw, heh in thou inla, hon doute thangpaihna dou ding in kisa inla; kei a ding in kihihhalh inla; vaihawmna ding thu na peta hi.
Huchi in michih omkhawmte'n hon umsuak uhen, huan, nang atung uah sangpi in kik nawn in.
TOUPA'N michih vai ahawmsak hi. TOUPA aw, keimah a ka diktatna leh ka lungsim hoihna om bang zel in vai hon hawmsak in.
Giloute gitlouhna hong tawp taleh aw, midiktatte hihkip in. Pathian diktat in lungtangte leh lungsimte a-enchian hi.
Pathian kiang ah ka phaw a-om, amah zaw lungtang dikpu hondampa ahi.
Pathian vaihawmpa diktat ahi, ahi, niteng in migiloute tung a lung hihlouhna nei Pathian ahi.
Mi akiheikik keileh ama'n anamsau tat-hiam in; thalpeu alai a, amanta hi.
Sihna vanzatte amah thahna ding in leng abawl dimdiam a; athalte kuangthei in abawl hi.
En in, gitlouhna in thulimlouhna apiangsak a; ahi, thilhihkhelhna apai a, zuauthu apiangsakta hi.
Kokhuk abawl a, thukpi in atou a, amah khuk toh ah aketa hi.
Athilhihkhelhna ama lutung mah ah ahong kik nawn ding, hiamgamtak a athilhih ama sip mah ah ake ding hi.
TOUPA adiktatna ziak in, akiang ah kipahthu ka gen ding; TOUPA tungnungpen min phat in la ka sa ding hi.
